name: agentready
description: AI Readiness Checker: scan a website and see how well AI crawlers can read it.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix agentready-api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix agentready-api run dev:memory" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix agentready-api run build && npm --prefix web run build
